membership_reason: Source pp.125–126 distinguishes commercial/noncommercial cephalopods38, shrimp/crab/lobster39, other benthic invertebrates40, euphausiids41 and invertebrate larvae42. Actual compatible taxa/stages, including larvae, remain candidates: provider functional bins alone do not prove adult-only reporting. Unobserved caught-stage composition and whole-pool proxy weighting are explicit. Unspecified larvae42 are a representative-stage extension, not an asserted exhaustive taxonomy.
allocation_reason: Complete accepted1998 group-export catch proportions proxy the reviewed mixture. Fixed across1950–2019 and landings/catch/discards; whole-guild mass and reconstructed source catch are not measured target composition.

membership_reason: Source Mulets includes shallow herbivorous/detrital Liza/Mugil and non-mullet Acanthurus/Sarpa, providing a positive shallow plant/detritus-feeding connection. Blackchin tilapia uses brackish lagoons/estuaries; it is not a mullet or source member. Coastal invertebrate/piscivore guilds and oceanic pools are less closely connected.
